query:
SELECT 
  'BOTH' as campaign,
  SUM(CASE WHEN enrichmentStatus != 'enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as need_enrich,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fitScore IS NULL AND enrichmentStatus = 'enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as need_fit_score,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (briefData IS NULL OR briefData = '') AND fitScore IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as need_brief,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '') AND briefData IS NOT NULL AND briefData != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as need_sales_only,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_no_sales
FROM companies WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003);
